description: Surfaced by fz-go4.18.8. compiler2_adding_a_defimpl_reprojects_only_the_cone_its_dispatch_reaches observes the LEGACY executable_transport.derived telemetry (world.define_executable_transport / Job::DeriveExecutableTransport). The native/product path deliberately does NOT emit it (native cutover moved off the legacy transport spine), and fz-go4.18.4 deletes DeriveExecutableTransport + ExecutableTransport. fz-go4.18.8 ported the test off Job::DeriveTransportPlan (driver now Job::LowerNativeProgram) and #[ignore]'d it with full assertions intact. TASK: add a product-path observable for per-executable transport (re)projection so the cone-scoped bounded-blast-radius property (adding an unrelated defimpl must NOT re-derive lonely's transport) is assertable on the shipping path; then un-ignore/retarget the test.
title: Re-establish the fz-g2f/fz-bfh.5.5 bounded-blast-radius signal on the product path
